positions.name: MeridianDeploymentGate
positions.frame: What does the Meridian deployment gate require, of which deploys, under whose ownership, and on what grounds?
positions.why: Both expressions read in one direction: the terms of a single release gate. src-1 performs the requirement in the CTO's voice — a binding rule on every Meridian deploy, scoped by the incident that motivated it (two unsigned artifacts reaching staging last quarter). src-2 records the same gate as a settled spec entry, fixing scope (staging and production) and owner (Quinton Fairweather). The set holds a footing tension worth keeping: one member is the decision performed by the position-holder, the other is the same decision recorded by a different author; the frame reads both as the gate's terms rather than resolving which voice is authoritative.
